# OwnX Progress

> Own1 is a personal AI computer you keep at home or in the office. Nexy is the assistant on it, and now on your laptop, your phone and in the cloud too, all connected to your own Own1 over a private network.

Updated 2026-11-21. Page: https://ownx-progress.vercel.app/

## Products
- Own1 (live): A personal AI computer: the AI runs on the box, and your data stays on hardware you own. Next: Owner approval for every outbound action, and proof of which software each box runs
- Own1 private desktop (live): A desktop only the owner can open, kept apart from the public demo. Next: Its own AI service, fully separate from the demo
- Nexy (live): One assistant for chat, research, projects and routines, the same wherever you run it. Next: One request built across all your devices at once, shown live
- Nexy Engine (live): The agent behind Nexy: a new engine in Rust, built to stay out of the AI model's way. Next: Smarter research on slower models
- Nexy for Mac and Windows (prototype): Nexy as a desktop app: on your own computer, in Nexy Cloud, or on your Own1. Next: Asking questions about a folder of documents
- Nexy for Android and iPhone (prototype): Nexy on your phone, powered by your own Own1 or Nexy Cloud. The phone needs no AI model of its own. Next: iPhone app
- Private network (prototype): An encrypted network joining your devices, where each device's address comes from its own key. Next: Your devices sharing AI: a phone using your Own1's GPU
- Nexy Cloud (prototype): Nexy hosted for you, for anyone without an Own1 yet. Next: Accounts with passkey sign-in, then GPU credits
- Earth Compute (live): A live map of what computing power costs around the world, by provider and region. Next: Choosing where cloud work runs, by price

## Shipped features, newest first (date merged)
- 2026-11-20, Own1: Every update tested on a brand-new Own1. Each change is built and booted on a fresh box before release, so new owners get exactly what was tested.
- 2026-11-20, Own1: Leaner AI services, rewritten in Rust. Device pairing and the AI gateway now run as small, fast programs, leaving more of the box for the AI models.
- 2026-11-19, Nexy Cloud: Nexy Cloud answers on a trusted Own1. Cloud users get answers from a full-size model on an Own1 that has spare capacity, and every reply says where it ran.
- 2026-11-19, Own1: One gateway for every AI model. A single service starts, shares and watches the box's models, and restarts one that stops responding.
- 2026-11-18, Own1: Choose what each device can do. The owner sets a device's access when approving it, and can change it at any time.
- 2026-11-18, Own1: Chat and images at the same time. The box keeps room for the text and image models together, so neither waits for the other.
- 2026-11-18, Nexy: One Nexy everywhere. Own1 runs the same Nexy as the apps and the web, so every improvement reaches every device at once.
- 2026-11-18, Own1: A choice of agent engines. Owners can run Nexy Engine or one of two other open-source agents, each with its own tools.
- 2026-11-18, Own1: Safer device pairing. Adding a device needs a recent owner sign-in and a single-use approval on the box.
- 2026-11-12, Own1: Owner mode and demo mode, one system. The same software runs a private owner box or a public demo, so the demo shows the real product.
- 2026-11-12, Own1: Devices page. Pair phones and laptops, hand out guest codes, and remove a device in one tap.
- 2026-11-12, Own1: Your devices use your Own1's AI. Paired laptops and phones run on the box's models, with the owner always first in line.
- 2026-11-12, Own1: Publish a page from your box. Share puts a saved page online and keeps it there until you unpublish it.
- 2026-11-12, Own1: Nexy on Telegram. Message your Own1's assistant from Telegram.
- 2026-11-04, Own1: Personal demo codes. Every visitor gets their own one-time code to try the demo desktop.
- 2026-10-28, Nexy: Turn a chat into a project. A conversation with several steps becomes a project you can come back to.
- 2026-10-28, Nexy: Take over the agent's browser. Watch the agent browse live, and take control yourself whenever you want.
- 2026-10-27, Image Studio: Image jobs wait their turn. A queued image waits for the graphics card instead of failing.
- 2026-10-26, Own Startup: AI employees that leave receipts. They work in their role, wait for your review and keep working with the tab closed.
- 2026-10-26, Nexy: Click any part of a page to edit it. Point at a heading or a footer and say what to change.
- 2026-10-26, App Store: Every NixOS package, 365 self-hosted apps. Browse, ask Nexy about an app, and open it with one link.
- 2026-10-26, Nexy: Routines that run around the clock. A new routine runs straight away, then on its schedule.
- 2026-10-26, Own1: Report a problem, kept on your box. Feedback is saved on the owner's own hardware, not sent away.
- 2026-10-26, Quality: One-command test suite. Every change is checked by an automated suite that writes a readable report.
- 2026-10-23, Own1: Nexy becomes the Own1 assistant. One always-on assistant across the whole desktop.
- 2026-10-23, Nexy: Edit the open page in place. Changes apply to the page you are looking at instead of rebuilding it.
- 2026-10-20, Own1: Four conversations at once. The text model now serves four requests at the same time.
- 2026-10-20, Own Build: Sites fix their own broken images. A build repairs missing images and clipped labels instead of failing.

## In review
- Own1: One address and one sign-in for the whole box. Every app on an Own1 opens from a single address after a single sign-in.
- Own1: Agents ready on the very first boot. A brand-new box has its assistant working the first time it starts.

## Planned
- Nexy Cloud: Accounts with passkey sign-in. Sign in with your phone's or laptop's passkey; no password to remember.
- Nexy Cloud: GPU credits. Buy credits for faster cloud GPUs when you need them; free use stays free.
- Nexy apps: iPhone app. Nexy on iPhone, joining Mac, Windows and Android.
